Engine: RPG Maker VX Ace
THE GAME
​
Introduction
​
In a world where wars are decided on sacred boards, chess pieces are not mere symbols… they are living warriors.
After the Black King broke the very laws of the game and mastered a forbidden power capable of repeating time endlessly, reality itself began to collapse. Kingdoms fell, memories shattered, and battles started to occur in eternal cycles.
You take on the role of a simple pawn — the weakest piece on the board — who mysteriously retains consciousness with every new loop. As you explore ruined kingdoms, forests scarred by ancient wars, and dimensions where time itself bends, you must fight, evolve, and uncover the truth behind the final move.
Face corrupted pieces, solve puzzles based on chess logic, and challenge fate in intense strategic battles. With each promotion, new abilities emerge. With each defeat, the world changes.
In the end, only one question remains:
Is checkmate the end… or the beginning?
